operations.name: models.deepgate.infer
operations.summary: Deepgate audio dataset - Select 1-20 WAV files: mono/stereo, 8-96 kHz, up to 30 seconds and 10 MB each, 20 MB total. Stereo is averaged; original sample rate is kept. MFCCs: 20 coefficients, FFT 2048, hop 512, 128 mel bands; first 32 frames, zero-padded when shorter. Returns a reconstruction score per recording; is_anomaly appears only when you provide a calibrated threshold. This is not speech transcription or whole-recording anomaly detection.

input_spec.label: Deepgate audio dataset

Returns a reconstruction score per recording; is_anomaly appears only when you provide a calibrated threshold. This is not speech transcription or whole-recording anomaly detection.

operations.name: models.mnist.edge_filter
operations.summary: MNIST 28 x 28 text data - Upload or paste exactly 28 rows with 28 space- or comma-separated pixel values per row. Any handwritten digit 0-9 is accepted. Use 0 for background and 1 for foreground, or grayscale 0-255 (thresholded at 128). Returns an edge map and summary, not a predicted digit. Only built-in demo samples 5 and 9 exist; use your own text for other digits.

operations.name: models.tcam.search
operations.summary: TCAM search image - Upload one PNG/JPEG image, up to 5 MB. The image becomes a 16-bit visual fingerprint and is searched against your entries (1-32 key/chunk_id records). Example entries are placeholders, not a trained image database. Returns query, matches, hit and chunk_id. Current API uses software PE emulation, not the physical TCAM FPGA runner.
